serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Fuck this guy, I will call the police anyway. 
You: Hello? Police?
Police's TTS(text to speech): Hello! You just contacted your local police department. 
Wait, what? Are there no operators these days? Isn’t this damaging to their reaction time or something?
Police's TTS: If there is a direct threat to your or anybody else’s life, press 1.
Police's TTS: If you are witnessing assault, rape or grand theft, press 2.
Police's TTS: If you want to report a hate crime, press 3.
Police's TTS: If you want to report tax evasion, press 4.
Police's TTS: If you want to report a kidnapping or missing person, press 5.
How many types of these are there?
Police's TTS: If you want to report a corruption or fraud, press 6.
Police's TTS: If you want to buy our premium membership, press 7.
...
Police's TTS: If you want to report any other crime, press 8.
Here we go, 8.
Police's TTS: Thank you for reporting crime! We want you to know that together with you we are making the world a better, safer place.
Thanks I guess. 
Police's TTS: The expected waiting time for our operator's response: 8 hours and 47 minutes. Thank you for your patience.
What?! Did something huge happen?! Second 9/11? President was kidnapped by aliens? Someone spray painted ALL LIVES MATTER on Kobe Bryant’s monument?! What caused this horrendous response time! 
I gotta check this really quick.
